SELECT * FROM course_package WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.package_id, a.slot_id, a.status, a.report_url, a.create_time, p.name AS package_name, p.coach_name, s.course_date, s.time_range FROM course_appointment a LEFT JOIN course_package p ON p.id = a.package_id LEFT JOIN course_slot s ON s.id = a.slot_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = #{status} AND a.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE course_slot SET current_count = current_count + 1, status = IF(current_count >= max_count, 'FULL', 'AVAILABLE') WHERE id = #{id} AND current_count < max_count AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_appointment ( user_id, slot_id, package_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slotId}, #{packageId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.package_id, a.slot_id, a.status, a.report_url, a.create_time, p.name AS package_name, p.coach_name, p.price, s.course_date, s.time_range FROM course_appointment a LEFT JOIN course_package p ON p.id = a.package_id LEFT JOIN course_slot s ON s.id = a.slot_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE course_appointment SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE course_appointment a LEFT JOIN course_slot s ON s.id = a.slot_id SET s.current_count = s.current_count - 1, s.status = IF(s.current_count < s.max_count, 'AVAILABLE', 'FULL') WHERE a.id = #{id} AND s.current_count > 0
